function: CSI feedback: a learnable linear projection at the user compresses downlink CSI; the BS reconstructs it with a learned sparse transform and an LSTM-based learning-to-optimize decoder (pp. 3-7).
system: Single-cell FDD massive MIMO: BS with 32-antenna ULA, single-antenna user, OFDM with 1024 subcarriers; indoor 5.3 GHz and outdoor 300 MHz; no RIS (pp. 3, 9).
method: Model-driven DL: learnable linear encoder, MLP sparse transform, element-wise LSTM learning-to-optimize decoder; trained end-to-end with MSE loss (called unsupervised), Adam (pp. 4-9).
data_channel: COST 2100 channels following CsiNet's setting: indoor 5.3 GHz and outdoor 300 MHz; 100,000 training, 30,000 validation, 20,000 test samples (p. 9).
test_conditions: Indoor and outdoor COST 2100 data; multi-rate test trains at compression 1/16 and tests other ratios without retraining; CsiNet retrained per ratio (pp. 9, 11).
baselines: ISTA (non-learned); learned: CsiNet, TransNet, TiLISTA, MS4L2O; multi-rate: SM-CsiNet+, PM-CsiNet+ (pp. 9, 11).
metrics: NMSE versus compression ratio, iterations, and quantization bits; encoder and decoder FLOPs and trainable parameters (pp. 9-12).
complexity: Orders in Table I (encoder O(Na Nt M)); FLOPs and parameters in Tables II-III, e.g., encoder 0.262 M FLOPs versus TransNet 17.072 M at 1/16 (pp. 8-10).
q1_support: p. 9: "two types of channel matrices are generated according to the COST 2100 models", indoor 5.3 GHz and outdoor 300 MHz.
q2_support: p. 11: "The proposed method in Fig. 7 is trained when compression ratio is 1/16 and directly test for other settings".
q3_support: p. 9: ISTA is "A classical CS algorithm without learning component"; CsiNet, TransNet, TiLISTA, and MS4L2O are earlier learned methods, all compared on NMSE in Figs. 4 and 5.
q4_support: p. 10: "TABLE II. The encoder-side FLOPs and trainable parameters number of different methods"; p. 8 gives the encoder order O(Na Nt M) and Table III the decoder FLOPs.
q5_support: p. 9: "two types of channel matrices are generated according to the COST 2100 models" by the authors; no link to code or data (the GitHub link in [35], p. 13, is the thop FLOPs counter).
notes: Included: the learned Csi-L2O performs CSI compression and feedback, so area 2. q5 to confirm: the 100,000/30,000/20,000 splits match the public COST 2100 dataset of CsiNet [9], but the paper only says the data are generated following [9] and gives no download link or code link. q2 counts the multi-rate test (trained at 1/16, tested at other compression ratios without retraining, p. 11); indoor and outdoor are separate scenarios and no cross-scenario test is reported. q3: ISTA is the non-learned baseline and the learned baselines are earlier CSI feedback methods.
